text:
Anya Li: Hey everyone, first day! I need access to a couple of secrets for a smoke test. Whats the quick Vault/KMS onboarding flow?

DevEx (Marta): Welcome Anya :wave: Short flow: 1) ensure SSO group membership, 2) submit Secrets Request (choose onboarding), 3) request short TTL or ephemeral token. Vault for secrets, KMS for keys.

Anya Li: Link to the form? Example description?

DevEx (Marta): https://console.redwood.internal/secrets/request. Example: "Onboarding: read-only access to staging/api-key for smoke tests; expires in 24h".

secrets-bot: SR-4952 created. Status: PENDING_REVIEW.

Anya Li: Do I ever get static creds for this?

Ravi (Security): We avoid static creds. For onboarding we issue dynamic Vault creds or ephemeral tokens tied to your identity. Typical TTL is 2-48h; up to 14d with justification. For anything longer we need an ops owner and rotation automation.

Sam (SRE): If you need to run a specific command, we can attach an ephemeral token scoped to that command. Add the command to SR-4952 and set the least privilege scope.

Anya Li: I added SR-4952: scope staging/api-key read-only, duration 4h, command ./scripts/smoke-test.sh.

secrets-bot: SR-4952 status: APPROVER_ASSIGNED (Ravi). ETA ~3h.

Ravi (Security): Approved. Sam, can you create the ephemeral token?

Sam (SRE): Token posted to SR-4952. Export like: export REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN=eyJ... (expires in 4h). Also added a short runbook snippet.

Anya Li: Token works, smoke tests passed. Thanks!

Ravi (Security): Note: onboarding secrets will be auto-scheduled for rotation. If you convert this to a service principal later, we require automated rotation and monitoring.

DevEx (Marta): Helpful checklist: confirm SSO group, be explicit about secret paths, prefer Vault dynamic creds, avoid committing keys, and tag tickets with owner/team.

Anya Li: One more Q: where to find docs on KMS vs HSM usage?

Ravi (Security): See docs: https://docs.redwood.internal/security/secrets/kms-hsm.md. TL;DR: Cloud KMS for app keys, HSM for regulated or export-controlled material. Ping security for mapping help.

Anya Li: Awesome, appreciate the speedy help :)
